newsitem.title: USA: Coopers & Lybrand buys AUTOFACTS consulting firm.
newsitem.headline: Coopers & Lybrand buys AUTOFACTS consulting firm.

text.p: Coopers & Lybrand LLP said Wednesday it acquired AUTOFACTS, an automotive forecasting and planning firm. Terms were not disclosed.

AUTOFACTS will become a division of Coopers & Lybrand Consulting. The firm provides automotive databases and reports, market research and systems and operational management consulting, among other things.
The firm's regional coverage includes North America, South America, eastern and western Europe, Africa-Middle East and Asia-Pacific, Coopers & Lybrand said.

Coopers & Lybrand said the acquisition "significantly enhances Coopers & Lybrand's ability to assess trends and provide unique insight about local and global issues for any company throughout the automotive supply chain."
Founded in 1985 by William Pochiluk, AUTOFACTS has offices in Detroit, Philadelphia and Europe. Pochiluk and his partner Peter Steinbach have become partners of Coopers & Lybrand LLP.
Coopers & Lybrand LLP provides professional services for enterprises in a wide range of industries.
